body:
Fixes #33

`sbxm rm <project>` defaulted to `--harness claude` and reported "no sandbox" for a project that only had a codex sandbox.

- `--harness` is now required on `open`, `stop` and `rm`. `rm --purge` needs no harness. `new` and `config show` keep the `claude` default.
- When the named harness has no sandbox but the project has others, the error names them and suggests `--harness <h>`.
- Tests, README and decision 135 updated. The decision is numbered 135 to follow the numbers used on `m2a-implementation`; `main` stops at 123.

`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass.

title: Require --harness on open, stop and rm
